name: Amaete ☆ Niini ~Babumi no aru Imouto-tachi wa, Ani no xxx ga Daisuki desu♥
original_name: あまえて☆にぃに ～バブみのある妹たちは、兄の×××が大好きです♥
source:
In a typical town—neither nestled in the countryside nor close to any major city center—
two young girls, still retaining an air of innocence and childlike charm, stepped down into a quiet residential neighborhood.

Holding smartphones in hand, they walked away from the bus stop and ventured deeper into the streets of houses, eventually stopping before one particular home and pressing its doorbell.

The door opened to reveal a young man—perplexed, yet wearing an awkward, hesitant smile.
He greeted the two girls and invited them inside.

This was the first meeting between the protagonist and his new stepsisters.
Due to their parents’ recent remarriage, the three had become step-siblings—and because of their parents’ work obligations, they were suddenly forced into living together…
Not just cohabitation, but living together entirely on their own, without parental supervision.

The protagonist sincerely wished to get along well with the two girls—but worn out by daily work, he struggled to bridge the gap as he’d hoped.

Then, one day, the girls embraced him—gently stroking his head and cheeks.
“You’ve done so well, Niini… Really well… So please, don’t push yourself too hard…”

The moment he instinctively pulled them close into his arms—
their first true, tender connection as siblings—and something more—began.
translation:
那是座再尋常不過的小城，既不在偏遠鄉間，也不靠近任何大都市的中心。
兩個還帶著幾分天真與稚氣的女孩下了車，走進一片寧靜的住宅區。

她們手拿智慧手機，離開公車站，穿過一條條住宅街，終於在一戶人家門前停下腳步，按響了門鈴。

開門的是個年輕男人，一臉困惑，卻還是遲疑地擠出一個不太自然的微笑。
他向兩個女孩打過招呼，請她們進了屋。

這是主角第一次見到新來的兩個繼妹。
不久前，雙方父母再婚，三個人成了沒有血緣的兄妹。又因為父母工作繁忙，他們突然不得不住在一起……
不只是住在一起，而且家裡只有他們三個，完全沒有父母照看。

主角真心想和兩個女孩處好關係，可每天的工作讓他精疲力竭，彼此的距離始終沒能如願拉近。

直到有一天，女孩們抱住了他，輕輕撫摸他的頭和臉頰。
「哥哥，你已經做得很好了……真的很好……所以，不要再勉強自己了……」

當他下意識地把她們攬進懷裡的那一刻——
三人才第一次真正感受到兄妹間的親密與溫情，而某種超越兄妹之情的東西也悄然萌生。
